name: nf-tax-amendments-objections
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island income-tax assessment correction and objection routes under current Australian law. Use for amendment periods, eligible business self-amendments, amended notices, nil assessments, late objections, delayed decisions and external review. Covers the distinct two-year and four-year clocks, retained prior-year regulations, prescribed exclusions, grounds, evidence and payment separation. Includes current primary legislation, authority guidance and fictional boundary components. Requires taxpayer capacity, income year, original and amended notices, giving or service evidence and verified route-specific dates. Preserves applicable workflow outputs and holds actual filings, complex disputes and unresolved facts. This draft does not complete the compliance or country pack.
